roles.metrics: Independent review of parent formulas and independent enumeration oracles; parent implemented shared-cost coupling after reported gap.
roles.runtime: Independent initial review found missing dispatch final state and duplicate launch protection; this reviewer then authored requested dispatch/pipeline fixes. Root retains independent review responsibility for those edits.

metrics.risk: Observed failure has exact strict-Y<q indicator; censor gives lower0 and upperI(q>c), missing q gives[0,1]. Infinities include admissible infinite lifetime.
metrics.paired_risk: Same latent censored Y used for both indicators. Equality cancels exactly, including equal infinite thresholds; missing pair conservatively[-1,1].
metrics.shared_cost: Shared specimen costs cancel from difference. Ratio(c+x)/(c+y) uses derivative sign(y-x) to choose common-cost endpoint after choosing exclusive endpoints. Different-row unknown costs retain rectangular bounds; identical shared support has exact ratio1 even at10M censor sensitivity.
metrics.rectangular_cost: Low-level interval helper gives conservative bounds without shared identity. Current scientific comparisons should use paired_ledger_cost_bounds; nonzero supports have positive observed lower costs, and k0 uses two empty ledgers.
metrics.source_weighting: Equal query means within episode, then seeds/condition/source; bootstrap only source-level means, never seed pseudo-replication.
metrics.bootstrap: 2000 source-resampling draws,RNG231. Strict interval suppressed when any supplied source is nonfinite or fewer2 finite. Mean field remains finite-source descriptive mean and must retain coverage/count labels.
metrics.caller_contract: Caller must retain/reindex expected source families and choose strict mode for strict claims. Helpers cannot detect an entirely absent source that was removed before their input.

runtime.full_pipeline_lock: Nonblocking ownership of whole8-stage pipeline; duplicate returns before writing status or starting a child.
runtime.global_dispatch_lock: Shared across inner/outer/caps to keep at most3workers and prevent duplicate leaf writes.
runtime.inherited_lock: Held descriptor passed to children; closing parent descriptor does not explicitly unlock it. Actual generated Python child retained flock after parent context exited, then released it on clean test exit.
runtime.process_safety: No shell interpolation, no kill/termination operations. Explicit Python executable,cwdROOT,thread environment1 and per-job PID/log/receipt.
runtime.states: Starting,running,and final complete/failed states; spawn errors and child nonzero exits remain failed, completed leaf shards preserved. Pipeline stops before dependent stages on failure.
runtime.freeze: Every pipeline/dispatcher verifies Experiment seal before launching children; each v6_run child independently verifies again. Freezer takes nonblocking lock around existing-seal/result checks and atomic JSON replace; refuses overwrite/existing actual result files.
runtime.freezer_hash_coverage: New pipeline and analysis modules included in RUNTIME.

scope.freeze_test: Only generated temporary files under patched module paths; no fatigue input/model code fit.
scope.runtime_test: Fake Experiment and mocked model subprocesses; one artificial Python stdin-wait child tested inherited OS flock, with no model/data access.

limitations: Source bootstrap remains descriptive under historical source dependence; not physical build confidence or R90C90.
Final new analysis consumer is separately authored/audited; this receipt proves helpers and execution scaffolding, not yet actual result arithmetic.
Direct low-level v6_run module calls can bypass dispatcher/pipeline ownership; prescribed entry point is run_v6.sh.
A prefit seal prevents later source drift but is not external proof of every historical manual action.
Runtime child may continue after parent interruption; inherited locks intentionally prevent duplicate launch until active children exit.
